title: Bazaarvoice pricing - Custom quote, $6,500 to $200,000+ annually
clean_text: Bazaarvoice charges roughly $10,000 to $200,000 or more per year depending on deployment size and feature scope, based on real client quotes gathered in 2025 and 2026. The lowest realistic entry point is approximately $6,500 to $15,000 per year for self-serve syndication-only access through the Open Network program, with limited features and no on-site ratings collection included. Each additional retail syndication destination, such as Walmart or Costco, is priced separately on top of the base platform fee.
